title: Plans and future
grammar: Going to, Present Continuous for future

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to talk about future plans using going to and the Present Continuous.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I am going to visit my aunt next week. We are meeting John at 7. She is going to study medicine. Notice the structure: am/is/are + going to + verb, or am/is/are + verb-ing for arrangements.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: I ___ visit my grandmother next Sunday.
phases.explanation: For plans we use am/is/are + going to + verb.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences about your plans for next weekend.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.explanation: For arrangements we use Present Continuous with future time expressions.
